title: PitchState
description: Payload of the pitch://state app event. Emitted whenever listening, rehearse-hold, the reference track, or the capture rate changes. Mirrors Rust struct audio::pitch::PitchState.

listening.description: True while the user has asked for live pitch (listen toggle or open Pitch Coach panel). Not set by track arm.

rehearseHold.description: True while the rehearse-hold key or button is down.

referenceTrackId.description: MIDI track whose clips are the target melody, or null when none is chosen.

deviceRate.description: Capture sample rate of the open input, or 0 when the hub is closed.
